name: Dr Billy Choi
photoAlt: Dr Billy Choi, Principal Dentist at Precision Dental
bio: Bachelor of Dental Science, University of Queensland. More than two decades practising in Brisbane, with a particular interest in caring for patients who feel anxious about dental visits.

name: Lizzy
photoAlt: Lizzy, Oral Health Therapist at Precision Dental
bio: As our oral health therapist, Lizzy plays a central role in helping patients keep their teeth and gums healthy for the long term. She provides professional check-ups and cleans, preventive treatments and oral hygiene advice, and she enjoys helping younger patients feel at ease during children's dentistry appointments. Lizzy takes the time to explain what she finds and to share practical tips that fit into everyday life.

name: Lidia
photoAlt: Lidia, Patient Coordinator at Precision Dental
bio: Lidia is usually the first person you speak with, whether on the phone, through our online enquiry form or at the front desk. She helps new patients settle in, arranges appointments around busy schedules and answers questions about health funds, payment plans and what to expect at your visit. If you ever need help, Lidia is a wonderful place to start.

name: Chrizza
photoAlt: Chrizza, Clinical Coordinator at Precision Dental
bio: Chrizza keeps the clinical side of the practice running smoothly. She coordinates treatment schedules, supports our clinicians and helps ensure that every part of your care, from preparation to follow-up, is organised and on time. For patients with longer or more involved treatment plans, Chrizza helps keep each step clear and well organised.

name: Haruna
photoAlt: Haruna, Dental Assistant at Precision Dental
bio: Haruna works chairside, supporting the dentist during treatment and helping patients feel comfortable throughout their appointment. She prepares treatment rooms, follows our infection prevention and control protocols and is always ready with a reassuring word.

name: Sheila
photoAlt: Sheila, Dental Assistant at Precision Dental
bio: Sheila assists during a wide range of dental procedures and takes pride in creating a calm, well-organised environment. She pays close attention to patient comfort and is happy to pause and check in whenever you need a moment.
